_comment: Hooks for java-plugin. PostToolUse: optionally format changed Java files via google-java-format or Spotless when present. Skips silently when neither is configured.

hooks.command: f="$CLAUDE_FILE"; case "$f" in *.java) [ -f pom.xml ] && grep -q 'spotless' pom.xml 2>/dev/null && ./mvnw -q spotless:apply -Dspotless.check.skip=true 2>/dev/null; [ -f build.gradle.kts ] && grep -q 'spotless' build.gradle.kts 2>/dev/null && ./gradlew -q spotlessApply 2>/dev/null; exit 0;; esac

bash -c 's=""; if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && [ -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/../sdlc/hooks/config-protection.sh" ]; then s="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/../sdlc/hooks/config-protection.sh"; elif [ -f "${PWD}/plugins/sdlc/hooks/config-protection.sh" ]; then s="${PWD}/plugins/sdlc/hooks/config-protection.sh"; fi; if [ -n "$s" ]; then exec bash "$s" 'checkstyle.xml' '.editorconfig'; fi; exit 0'
hooks.description: Protect this stack's tooling config (checkstyle.xml;.editorconfig) from being edited mid-run to make a diff pass. Denies only while an sdlc run state file is fresh and task_type is not chore; silent otherwise.

hooks.command: bash -c 's=""; if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && [ -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/../sdlc/hooks/post-implement-check.sh" ]; then s="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/../sdlc/hooks/post-implement-check.sh"; elif [ -f "${PWD}/plugins/sdlc/hooks/post-implement-check.sh" ]; then s="${PWD}/plugins/sdlc/hooks/post-implement-check.sh"; fi; if [ -n "$s" ]; then exec bash "$s" ./mvnw -q compile; fi; exit 0'
hooks.description: Batched post-implement check: runs `./mvnw -q compile` once after this stack's architect finishes and relays failures to the orchestrator as a retry hint. Silent when the tool is absent or no run is active.
